top_signals.title: Fratelli Cosulich Takes Delivery of Third Methanol-Ready Bunker Tanker
top_signals.summary: Italian shipowner Fratelli Cosulich has taken delivery of Carlotta Cosulich, the third of four methanol-ready bunker tankers being built under its fleet expansion program.The 8,585 deadweight tonne (DWT) vessel was officially delivered at Taizhou Maple Leaf Shipyard in China on October 28…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CrowdStrike's new kill switch can stop rogue AI agents in their tracks, CEO says
top_signals.summary: "Enabling agents to work safely is a massive market opportunity for CrowdStrike," CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz told CNBC's Jim Cramer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
